evidence.text: Developed a 38-variable logistic regression application scorecard for personal loans from four years of booked-loan outcomes, binning each variable under monotonic weight-of-evidence constraints.
evidence.notes: Clear evidence of logistic regression scorecard development.

evidence.text: Ran out-of-time validation on the latest twelve months of applications and wrote up the Gini, calibration and stability results for the validation file, including a comparison with the incumbent scorecard's Gini on the same sample.
evidence.notes: Clear evidence of out-of-time validation and documentation.

evidence.text: Prepared the scorecard's release package (coefficients, cut-off table, test cases) and checked the decision engine's test-environment outputs against the development code case by case before rollout, logging 400 test cases with matching outputs.
evidence.notes: Clear evidence of model rollout support.

evidence.text: Produced the monthly monitoring report after release, tracking population stability by score band and 90-day arrears by monthly cohort.

evidence.text: Ran a champion-challenger simulation of the new scorecard against the incumbent on historic applications and presented the results to the pricing working group, which used it when choosing the cut-off for the new scorecard.
evidence.notes: The candidate presented results to a working group, but not explicitly to a credit committee.
